target_scope: predictor attention including dependency cross-attention; tokenizer frozen
loss: official head.compute_loss two-level next-token cross entropy, all shifted positions
epoch_definition: each asset-origin Jan1-25 stride120 window once, shuffled deterministically per epoch, no replacement
normalization: cast OHLCVA to float32 first, then mean/std of first256 only, eps1e-5, clip5; same numerical preprocessing as installed sktime KronosPredictor
ranking: competition rank <=2, retain ties and disclose set sizes
dynamic_baseline: std(ddof=0) of 255 log returns in 256 input closes times sqrt(30)
small_pass: exact-set hit rate strictly greater than dynamic naive, January-frozen fixed pair, and original Kronos on complete paired grid
major_pass: exact-set point estimate greater than or equal to dynamic naive minus0.02 on complete paired grid
mae_role: small-tier checkpoint selection; if best February candidate MAE >= original on same300 grid then stop with interim and March sealed
failure_policy: retain all scheduled windows, report failures/coverage; incomplete paired grid prevents acceptance
fixed_pair_policy: maximize exact-set hits on Jan1-25 training origins, ties lexicographic asset pair; freeze before model inference
deadline_policy: conservative interpretation of tomorrow morning; before unseal reserve measured two-model300-window test plus20min; if insufficient produce interim without March access
timing_policy: microbench is formal epoch1 after resetting smoke model/optimizer/RNG; count it once
observation_policy: 48 fixed calendar-only origins (8/day Jan26-31); evaluate original and each completed epoch; no checkpoint, pair or parameter selection from observation

observation_addendum.max_drawdown: close path running-peak maximum drawdown including P0; pathwise then mean
observation_addendum.top3_ties: B-line expected recall with fractional inclusion at cutoff ties
observation_addendum.decision_use: none; logs and reports only, no early stop/checkpoint/gates/loss effect
